claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_on_hit_trigger_effectatom_payload
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items can already use an on-hit trigger family, but the current payload union is mastery-shaped and cannot grant direct extra damage on hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_area_attachment_for_magic_item_auras
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Passive mechanics currently grant unconditional effects to the bearer only; they cannot attach an always-on aura to an emanation affecting friendly creatures in an area.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot Emanation originating from you. You and all creatures Friendly to you in the Emanation have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_area_size_threshold_scaling
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The passive item surface has no way to scale an attached aura's geometry by class level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the Emanation increases to 30 feet.
